script_hooks.logic:
Let container be the group of the enemy.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then decrease the register's '_remainingTurnsToReuseReflect' by one.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v2 be call v with (container).
  If the register's '_remainingTurnsToReuseReflect' is at most 0 and call helper with (the enemy), then set the register's '_remainingTurnsToReuseReflect' to the numeric entry "sorceress1_minimum_turns_to_reuse_reflect" in the battle settings of container and stop.
  Let ability be the id of the move labelled list on the enemy.
  Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
  If the length of v2 is 0, then set withoutAbilityList to withoutAbilityList → concat with (ability).
  Let ability2 be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
  If ability contains ability2, then
    Let v3 be a random pick from v2.
    The enemy uses ability2 with options {activeTarget: v3}.
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability2.

flow.text: Let container be the group of the enemy.
condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame
the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let v2 be call v with (container).
the register's '_remainingTurnsToReuseReflect' is at most 0 and call helper with (the enemy)
Set the register's '_remainingTurnsToReuseReflect' to the numeric entry "sorceress1_minimum_turns_to_reuse_reflect" in the battle settings of container.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled list on the enemy.
Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
Set withoutAbilityList to withoutAbilityList → concat with (ability).
Let ability2 be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
Let v3 be a random pick from v2.
The enemy uses ability2 with options {activeTarget: v3}.
